description: Retrieve all contacts for the current organization with optional filtering by search term, tag, and pagination.

doNotAutoRespond.description: Filter to contacts the bot will never (true) / may (false) auto-respond to

doNotBroadcast.description: Filter to contacts that are (true) or are not (false) excluded from broadcasts

search.description: Search term to filter contacts by name, phone number, or email address

tag.description: Tag name to filter contacts by category
